intent: Original boss-specific full-frame pattern textures; Touhou spell-background print and layered motion reference. No original game image copied.

themes.detail: Theme: the spirit of forgotten lantern-light and names. Build flowing oversized chrysanthemum petals, interlocking sixfold hemp-leaf (asanoha) lace and curling flames shaped like flower stamens, clipped organically at the edges. Warm cinnabar, muted burnt vermilion and antique copper etching over oxblood and smoky plum ink. Distinct broad diagonal floral ribbons, old gold print-registration traces, hand-drawn woodcut hatching. A warm strongly graphic Japanese patterned-paper field; NOT a magic circle or literal lantern.

themes.detail: Theme: rain carrying unwritten letters. Make elongated sinuous blue ink currents braided with slender falling rain-line engravings and occasional angular folds integrated into the ornamental field. Pale slate-blue and subdued turquoise etching over indigo-black, misty midblue washes between distinct sweeping bands. Dense linear contours like rain-blurred washi marbling and flowing handwriting made entirely of abstract marks, NO legible writing or literal envelopes. Predominantly vertical, graceful with asymmetric open eddies.

themes.detail: Theme: ferries crossing rivers that have forgotten their banks. A flowing field of layered Japanese seigaiha wave curls, broad irregular spiral eddies, intricate topographic water contour lines and overlapping rounded ripples. Dull jade, sea-green and muted pale bronze engraved lines over deep petrol teal and dark navy. Large displaced oval vortices woven through rhythmic waves; no boats, shore, realistic water, lanterns or scenery. The texture feels like an antique Japanese wave woodcut turned into an otherworldly optical pattern.

themes.detail: Theme: a silk-weaving spider joining fragments of memory. Curving bands of plum-purple silk expressed as flat brocade, intricate intersecting golden warp and weft linework, incomplete eight-spoked fan rosettes woven into flowing diamond cells. Restrained lilac, mauve and antique brass lines over black-aubergine and muted mulberry. Elegant layered Japanese textile print with fine thread engraving, large swooping asymmetrical crossings. No realistic cloth folds, spiders, looms, objects, rigid straight checkerboards or central mandala.

themes.detail: Theme: an austere paper-shikigami guardian of a book containing lost names. Interlocking irregular labyrinthine seal-carving strokes, nested rectangular paper-fold contours and fanlike leaf veins blend into an intricate ornamental all-over blockprint. Moss green, faded olive ivory and sparse dull red vermilion stamps over near-black forest green. Angular folded shapes break into graceful curved strips like records unwinding; NO readable characters, kanji, letters, actual book illustrations or labels. Flat antique ink-rubbing texture, bold large motifs plus fine dry-brush engraved detail.

themes.detail: Theme: the final guardian of all unspoken names, solemn and dreamlike. Grand overlapping auspicious cloud scrolls, elegant lotus-petal contour fans and broken concentric echo waves interwoven into a flowing Japanese sacred textile design. Cool deep indigo and dark muted violet foundation, subdued blue-grey and antique gold engraved outlines with rare desaturated seafoam bands. Multiple off-center swirling chambers, stately large arcs and fine filigree, NOT a single central emblem or starry space. Ornamental flat cloud print, no literal clouds in a sky, bells, human forms or inscriptions.

themes.detail: Theme: the Extra boss's inverted bells, fractured echoes and mirrored identities. Interwoven mirrored feather-shaped curls, alternating S-shaped moire bands, curved glass-cut contour hatching, scarlet narrow ribbons threaded through broad cobalt ornamental waves. Deep midnight blue and dark violet with restrained silver-indigo lines and dusty crimson accents. Bold strange asymmetrical kaleidoscopic Japanese paper pattern, roughly bilateral fragments offset from each other, dizzying but not overly fine. No shards rendered as 3D objects, literal mirrors, bells, triangles, concentric target circles or neon lights.
